title: BPW-2026-0463
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0463
BOE + BCA
CD ALL
REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS (RFQ) AND NEGOTIATE PERSONAL SERVICES CONTRACTS – VARIOUS PUBLIC WORKS PROJECTS
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue and advertise the transmitted RFQ to geotechnical and environmental engineering consultants for various public works projects;
AUTHORIZE the staff from the Department of Public Works to evaluate and pre-qualify the respondents based upon the requirements and procedures set forth in the RFQ;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to negotiate a personal services contract with each of the highest rated and most responsive firms; and
DIRECT the City Engineer to report to the Board with recommendations on executing the negotiated contracts.
summary: Issue request for qualifications for geotechnical and environmental engineering consultants for various public works projects.

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
